$comment: Seed alias dictionary for packages/resolve, tier 2. Every entry is a (normalised component name -> PURL base) pair OBSERVED in the corpus, not invented. Entries where the same name mapped to competing PURLs at under 80 percent dominance were dropped rather than guessed; the count is recorded below because that ambiguity is the real problem the resolver exists to handle. Built from the TRAIN SPLIT ONLY. The seven held-out files are never used here, so bench/identity measures generalisation rather than recall of its own input.
normalisation: lowercase, strip common archive extensions, collapse whitespace and underscores to hyphens, strip a trailing version token
warning: This seed is small and skewed toward the corpus's ecosystems. It is a floor to beat, not a finished dictionary. The real dictionary is seeded from the AboutCode PURL database and grows every time a human confirms a resolution in the workspace.
